svg.title: Five Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-five-to-seven-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Five Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions; subtitle: Conservative and Base: 2 FT + 3 C; Scaled: 3 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each stage represents one person, with numeric_value equal to one seat. The first five seats form the active core pod; the last two are conditional scale additions. Contractor seats represent retained people, not full-time labor commitments.; caption: Keep commercial ownership and operational control in the two core full-time seats. Add the third full-time seat and fourth contractor only when workload and funded economics support them.; stages: label: Channel principal; value: Core seat one: full-time commercial owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own vendor relationships, deal registration, pricing exceptions, strategic accounts, and contribution review. Check channel conflict before promising exclusivity.; label: Revenue operations lead; value: Core seat two: full-time operating owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own quote generation, CRM hygiene, purchase-order matching, license reconciliation, receivables aging, and automated renewal alerts tied to verified contract dates.; label: Implementation architect; value: Core seat three: scoped delivery contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Translate discovery into a bounded deployment plan, estimate integrations, define acceptance tests, and prevent unpaid implementation work from absorbing spread.; label: License operations specialist; value: Core seat four: entitlement reconciliation contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Match ordered products to customer tenants and active seats, investigate vendor invoice discrepancies, and produce evidence for renewal quantity decisions.; label: Technical support specialist; value: Core seat five: scheduled support contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Handle defined support windows, document recurring incidents, escalate product defects to the vendor, and keep unsupported customizations outside standard scope.; label: Expansion account manager; value: Scaled addition: third full-time operating seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Activate for the seven-person model to own expansion and renewal negotiations. Measure contribution retained and overdue balances, not merely booked contract value.; label: Migration delivery specialist; value: Scaled addition: fourth retained contractor seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Activate when signed implementation backlog exceeds the core delivery bench. Use project-specific statements of work and maintain independent acceptance evidence.

text.title: Five Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions

rect.title: label: Channel principal; value: Core seat one: full-time commercial owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own vendor relationships, deal registration, pricing exceptions, strategic accounts, and contribution review. Check channel conflict before promising exclusivity.

text.title: Own vendor relationships, deal registration, pricing exceptions, strategic accounts, and contribution review. Check channel conflict before promising exclusivity.

rect.title: label: License operations specialist; value: Core seat four: entitlement reconciliation contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Match ordered products to customer tenants and active seats, investigate vendor invoice discrepancies, and produce evidence for renewal quantity decisions.

text.title: Match ordered products to customer tenants and active seats, investigate vendor invoice discrepancies, and produce evidence for renewal quantity decisions.

rect.title: label: Expansion account manager; value: Scaled addition: third full-time operating seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Activate for the seven-person model to own expansion and renewal negotiations. Measure contribution retained and overdue balances, not merely booked contract value.

text.title: Activate for the seven-person model to own expansion and renewal negotiations. Measure contribution retained and overdue balances, not merely booked contract value.

rect.title: label: Migration delivery specialist; value: Scaled addition: fourth retained contractor seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Activate when signed implementation backlog exceeds the core delivery bench. Use project-specific statements of work and maintain independent acceptance evidence.

text.title: Activate when signed implementation backlog exceeds the core delivery bench. Use project-specific statements of work and maintain independent acceptance evidence.

Assumptions: Each stage represents one person, with numeric_value equal to one seat. The first five seats form the active core pod; the last two are conditional scale additions. Contractor seats represent retained people, not full-time labor commitments.
